description: Lists the Search Console properties synced for the signed-in account: id, siteUrl (Search Console format), displayName, tags, branded_terms (used by the brand filter), whether GA4/Bing are mapped and the data coverage (dataFrom/dataTo, web search). Use it first when you do not know the exact name of a site or need the date range available. Default: visible properties only. / Propriedades da conta com cobertura de dados.
